### PPI

We use the [Producer Price Index by Commodity: Farm Products: Slaughter Cattle (WPU0131)](hhttps://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0131) to put all data in 2025 dollars. Data are not seasonally adjusted (seasonally adjusted data not available for our years of interest). Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index by Commodity: Farm Products: Slaughter Cattle \[WPU0131\], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0131, August 17, 2026.

For retail and wholesale prices, we use the [Producer Price Index by Commodity: Processed Foods and Feeds: Meats (WPU0221)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0221)("WPU0221.csv").

Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index by Commodity: Processed Foods and Feeds: Meats \[WPU0221\], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0221, August 17, 2026.

We compute an average yearly PPI and then use that to convert all dollars into 2025 dollars.

```{r}

# import ppi
ppi <- read_csv("../data_raw/WPU0131.csv") %>%
  clean_names()

# Create 2025 ppi index: yearly average, then index relative to 2025
ppi <- ppi %>%
  mutate(year = year(observation_date)) %>%
  filter(year>=2018 & year<2026) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(ppi = mean(wpu0131, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(ppi_index_2025 = ppi[year == 2025] / ppi) %>%
  select(year, ppi_index_2025)

producer_ppi <- ppi

# Import retail/wholesale ppi
ppi <- read_csv("../data_raw/WPU0221.csv") %>% 
  filter(observation_date>= as.Date("2018-01-01"))

# PPI get average per year
ppi <- ppi %>% 
  mutate(year = year(observation_date)) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(ppi = mean(WPU0221, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(retail_wholesale_ppi_index_2025 = ppi[year == 2025] / ppi) %>% 
  select(-ppi)

retail_wholesale_ppi <- ppi

rm(ppi)
```

### Commodity

#### Farmgate

Data is from the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS), Livestock Marketing LM_CT168, National Weekly Direct Cow and Bull Report - Negotiated Price. Data were provided by USDA Field Chief at AMS Livestock Poultry and Grain Market News. Prices are reported as weighted average price per CWT.

Data is for the Eastern Area, which includes the following 26 states: Alabama, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Maryland, Maine, Michigan, Mississippi, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, Vermont, Wisconsin and West Virginia.

The price received by the producer is the weighted average dressed price, Boner (85% lean), 500 lbs and up.

We first get an average and standard deviation for each year and then an average and standard deviation from 2018-2025. While we do have data through 2026, we only have data through 2025 of the rest of the supply chain.

We use the [Producer Price Index by Commodity: Farm Products: Slaughter Cattle (WPU0131)](hhttps://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0131) to put all data in 2025 dollars. Data are not seasonally adjusted (seasonally adjusted data not available for our years of interest). Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index by Commodity: Farm Products: Slaughter Cattle \[WPU0131\], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0131, August 17, 2026.

```{r}

# import data
df <- read_csv("../data_raw/Datamart-Export_LM_CT168-Detail_20261019_112711.csv") %>% 
  clean_names() 

# Keep data of interest
df <- df %>% 
  filter(
    classification=="Boner (85% lean)" &  
      selling_basis=="DRESSED" & 
      weight_range=="500 lbs and up" & 
      region_name=="Eastern Area"
  ) 

# Make date correct format, create year column, join PPI index, convert to 2025 dollars
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    report_date = mdy(report_date),
    year = year(report_date)
  ) %>%
  filter(year<2026) %>%
  left_join(producer_ppi, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(real_price_2025dollars = weighted_avg_price * ppi_index_2025) %>%
  select(year, report_date, ppi_index_2025, everything())

# Yearly Mean/SD
sum_year <- df %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(
    farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean = mean(real_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE), 
    farmgate_price_2025dollars_sd = sd(real_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    year = as.character(year)
  )

# 10 year mean/sd
sum <- df %>% 
  summarise(
    farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean = mean(real_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE), 
    farmgate_price_2025dollars_sd = sd(real_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    year = "2018-2025"
  )

# Combine
farmgate_price <- bind_rows(sum, sum_year) %>% 
  select(year, everything())

# Figure of monthly average weighted price per CWT (2025 dollars)
ggplot(df, aes(x = report_date, 
           y = real_price_2025dollars)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Weighted average price per CWT (2025 dollars)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

rm(df, sum, sum_year)
```

#### Wholesale, retail

We use [Meat Price Spreads data from the USDA Economic Research Service, Historical monthly price spread data for beef, pork, broilers](https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/meat-price-spreads).

We start with the same year available for slaughter cattle, 2018, but only have data through 2025, 2018-2025. All prices are reported in 2025 dollars.

We do not have data specifically on culled cows, but assume the price spreads are similar to those reported here.

For retail and wholesale prices, we use the [Producer Price Index by Commodity: Processed Foods and Feeds: Meats (WPU0221)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0221)("WPU0221.csv").

Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index by Commodity: Processed Foods and Feeds: Meats \[WPU0221\], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0221, August 17, 2026.

We compute an average yearly PPI and then use that to convert all dollars into 2025 dollars.

```{r}

# Import USDA ERS price spread data
df <- read_csv("../data_raw/history.csv") %>% 
  clean_names()

# Keep beef data since 2018
df <- df %>% 
  filter(year>=2018 & 
           str_detect(data_item, "beef"))


# Keep data of interest - we do not use the farm value here
df <- df %>% 
  filter(data_item %in% c(
    "Choice beef wholesale value",
    "Choice beef retail value"
  ))

# Make year-month date
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    date = make_date(year, month_number, 1)
  )

# Join with data 
df <- df %>% 
  left_join(retail_wholesale_ppi)

rm(ppi)

# Convert prices to 2025 dollars
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    real_beef_price_2025dollars = value*retail_wholesale_ppi_index_2025)

# Yearly Mean/SD
sum_year_retail <- df %>% 
  filter(data_item=="Choice beef retail value") %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(
    retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean =
      mean(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    retail_beef_price_2025dollars_sd =
      sd(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    year = as.character(year)
  )

sum_year_wholesale <- df %>% 
  filter(data_item=="Choice beef wholesale value") %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(
    wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean =
      mean(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_sd =
      sd(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    year = as.character(year)
  )

sum_year <- sum_year_retail %>% 
  left_join(sum_year_wholesale)
rm(sum_year_retail, sum_year_wholesale)

# 10 year mean/sd
sum_retail <- df %>% 
  filter(data_item=="Choice beef retail value") %>%
  summarise(
    retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean =
      mean(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    retail_beef_price_2025dollars_sd =
      sd(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 

sum_wholesale <- df %>% 
  filter(data_item=="Choice beef wholesale value") %>%
  summarise(
    wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean =
      mean(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_sd =
      sd(real_beef_price_2025dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 

sum <- bind_cols(sum_wholesale, sum_retail) %>% 
  mutate(
    year = "2018-2025"
  )
rm(sum_wholesale, sum_retail)

# Combine
wholesale_retail_price <- bind_rows(sum, sum_year) %>% 
  select(year, everything())

rm(sum, sum_year)

#Choice beef wholesale value
ggplot(df %>% 
         filter(data_item=="Choice beef wholesale value"), 
       aes(x = date, 
           y = real_beef_price_2025dollars)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Price (2025 Cents per pound of retail equivalent)",
    title = "Real monthly Choice beef wholesale value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


# Choice beef retail value
ggplot(df %>% 
         filter(data_item=="Choice beef retail value"), 
       aes(x = date, 
           y = real_beef_price_2025dollars)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Price (2025 Cents per pound of retail equivalent)",
    title = "Real monthly Choice beef retail value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

### Organic

Using data from the [USDA AMS Livestock, Poultry, and Grain Market News, New York Dept of Ag Mrkt News, Feb 5, 2025](https://www.ams.usda.gov/mnreports/ams_3789.pdf), we estimate the increased cost of organic beef at the farmgate.

Data are pulled from Slaughter Cattle, Dairy Cows, we use DAIRY COWS - Lean 85-90% (Per Cwt / Actual Wt) as it has the largest sample size. The average price per cwt/actual wt for conventional is 116.98 and for organic is 118.78. Organic is 1.5% higher than conventional. We apply a 1.8% premium on farmgate organic prices.

Retail prices are found from the [USDA AMS Livestock, Poultry, & Grain Market News, Weekly Grocery Store Beef Feature Activity, August 14, 2026](https://www.ams.usda.gov/mnreports/ams_3228.pdf). We apply the prices differences of conventional to organic to both retail and wholesale. We use the price of ground beef, Ground Beef 80-89%, 1-2 Lbs from the Previous Week (PW).

Conventional: 6.26 USDA Organic, fresh: 6.99

We apply a 11.7% premium on all retail and wholesale organic prices.

```{r}

# Define how much to inflate prices for organic
organic_farmgate <- (118.78-116.98)/116.98
organic_retail_wholesale <- (6.99-6.26)/6.26

# Define organic farmgate price
farmgate_price <- farmgate_price %>% 
  mutate(
    organic_farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean = farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean + (farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean*organic_farmgate)
  )

# Define organic price wholesale retail
wholesale_retail_price <- wholesale_retail_price %>% 
  mutate(
    organic_wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean = 
      wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean + (wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean*organic_retail_wholesale), 
    organic_retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean = 
      retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean + (retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean*organic_retail_wholesale)
)
```

### Combine and save

For the model, [we include one worksheet with differentiated prices, one with commodity beef prices at each level of the supply chain](https://github.com/FoodSystemsModeling/CityFoodPolicy/tree/main/beef/data_final/beef_price.xlsx). All prices are in 2024 dollars. They are reported as the average from 2018-2024 and in each year.

Convert all prices into \$/kg. 1 kg = 2.20462 lb

- Farmgate price is reported in price per CWT
- Wholesale and retail price is reported in Cents per pound of retail equivalent
- cents/kg=cents/lb×2.20462
- \$/kg=100cents/lb×2.20462

We also keep a table with all of the data to be used for validation.

#### Commodity

```{r}

# Combine all commodity data
beef_price <- farmgate_price %>% 
  left_join(wholesale_retail_price)

# Convert to price per kg
# Farmgate: $/CWT → $/kg  (CWT = 100 lbs; $/lb = $/CWT / 100; $/kg = $/lb * 2.20462)
# Wholesale/retail: cents/lb → $/kg  ($/lb = cents/lb / 100; $/kg = $/lb * 2.20462)

beef_price <- beef_price %>%
  mutate(
    # Farmgate ($/CWT)
    farmgate_price_kg_mean              = (farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean / 100) * 2.20462,
    farmgate_price_kg_sd                = (farmgate_price_2025dollars_sd   / 100) * 2.20462,
    organic_farmgate_price_kg_mean      = (organic_farmgate_price_2025dollars_mean / 100) * 2.20462,
    # Wholesale (cents/lb)
    wholesale_price_kg_mean             = (wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean / 100) * 2.20462,
    wholesale_price_kg_sd               = (wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_sd   / 100) * 2.20462,
    organic_wholesale_price_kg_mean     = (organic_wholesale_beef_price_2025dollars_mean / 100) * 2.20462,
    # Retail (cents/lb)
    retail_price_kg_mean                = (retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean / 100) * 2.20462,
    retail_price_kg_sd                  = (retail_beef_price_2025dollars_sd   / 100) * 2.20462,
    organic_retail_price_kg_mean        = (organic_retail_beef_price_2025dollars_mean  / 100) * 2.20462
  )

info <- c(
  "=== farmgate_price ===",
  "Description: Price received by the producer is the weighted average dressed price, Boner (85% lean), 500 lbs and up. Prices are reported as weighted average price per CWT in the original data and converted to price per kg in the final data.",
  "Source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS), Livestock Marketing LM_CT168, National Weekly Direct Cow and Bull Report - Negotiated Price. Data were provided by USDA Field Chief at AMS Livestock Poultry and Grain Market News.",
  "",
  "=== wholesale_retail_price ===",
  "Description: Choice beef wholesale and retail value (in 2025 dollars). Data are reported as a yearly average and as an average from 2018-2025. Original data are in cents per pound of retail equivalent, converted to price per kg.",
  "Source: Meat Price Spreads data from the USDA Economic Research Service, Historical monthly price spread data for beef, pork, broilers."
)

# Save info
writeLines(info, "../data_final/beef_commodity_price.txt")

# Differentiated
write_csv(beef_price, "../data_final/beef_commodity_price.csv")

```
